certification_policies.rationale: Backend Certification requires the completed audit authority and every production-blocking obligation resolved by its owning phase.

obligations.description: Recover orphaned RUNNING agent turns without permanent session unavailability.
obligations.proof_expectation: Real PostgreSQL lease takeover and stale-worker fencing; reconcile ambiguous effects without fresh redispatch identity.

obligations.description: Recover orphaned workflow claims and reconcile ambiguous tool or agent effects through owning authorities.
obligations.proof_expectation: Deterministic crash, claim takeover and ambiguity tests across replicas, preserving P08/P13 authority.

obligations.description: Recover stale scheduler claims and reconcile dispatch outcomes through P14 idempotency.
obligations.proof_expectation: Prove stale-owner rejection, bounded recovery and one logical workflow start after ambiguous dispatch.

obligations.description: Recover expired assignment leases and reconcile downstream human-agent operations.
obligations.proof_expectation: Prove no stale owner can mutate and no ambiguous send is blindly repeated after takeover.

obligations.description: Reconcile Sentinel AMBIGUOUS execution outcomes without automatic redispatch under new identity.
obligations.proof_expectation: Prove explicit downstream evidence, stable idempotency and generation fencing under crash/recovery.

obligations.description: Audit cross-phase concurrency tests: fixed sleeps cannot prove happens-before ordering.
obligations.proof_expectation: Use committed state, durable permits, leases/fences or observable external entry barriers; retain regression evidence across P00-P22.

obligations.description: Dependency security is time-sensitive: new direct or transitive advisories invalidate current clearance.
obligations.proof_expectation: Prove frozen dependency integrity, fresh candidate scans and blocking treatment of newly disclosed findings; historical PASS remains historical.

obligations.description: Repeated SIP integration timing instability requires root-cause diagnosis; cause remains unproven.
obligations.proof_expectation: Preserve failures, reproduce under representative load and synchronize observable boundaries without weaker assertions or arbitrary timeout increases.
